name: schedule_list
description: List all registered scheduled tasks in z-schedule, optionally filtered by executor group. Returns a JSON array of JobInfo objects with id, jobDesc, jobCron, triggerStatus (0=stopped, 1=running), triggerLastTime, triggerNextTime, executorHandler, and executorParam. Use this when the CEO agent needs an overview of what's running, to find a task ID before triggering/removing it, or to audit the schedule inventory.

jobGroup.description: Executor group ID to filter by. 0 (default) returns all groups. Use a specific group ID to narrow down.
